description: EXECUTE a capability now (paid). Use only when the user wants the capability to run — not for price checks (hydracept_quote_capability), status (hydracept_job_status), or receipts (hydracept_get_receipt). Default wait=true blocks until terminal; use hydracept_submit_job when execution is required but this call must not block. Hosted POST .../jobs when the descriptor supports jobs; invoke-only descriptors use POST .../invoke. Auth: bearer required. Cost: paid — admission reserves a hold at the primary model's worst-case price (capped by max_cost or account ceiling); charge settles at actual cost with no per-call minimum. Side effects: executes the capability (may be irreversible); creates job/artifact records when applicable.

body.description: Required capability input object (schema fields). Merged with session project context when bound.
body.title: Body

capability_key.description: Required capability registry key for POST .../jobs.
capability_key.title: Capability Key

idempotency_key.description: Optional string; server generates run-{uuid} when empty. Reuse for safe retries.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

input.description: Alias for body; do not pass both.
input.title: Input

max_cost.description: Optional number (USD): sets execution.executionConstraints.maxCostUsd before submit.
max_cost.title: Max Cost

timeout.description: Seconds to poll when wait=true; omit to poll until terminal with no tool-side limit (the MCP client request timeout may end the call first). On timeout, status may stay running — call hydracept_job_status.
timeout.title: Timeout

wait.description: Boolean, default true. When true, poll until succeeded/failed/canceled or timeout. When false, return job id and poll with hydracept_job_status.
wait.title: Wait

name: hydracept_run
title: Run a capability
